name: colMedians
title: Calculates the median for each row (column) in a matrix

origin.description: Calculates the median for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colMedians(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, dim. = dim(x),
  ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded first, otherwise not.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: colMedians calls the same C routine as rowMedians with byrow FALSE, which swaps the two margins. Integer matrices use a separate path so the values are not coerced to double before the median is taken. The installed function always returns a double vector. When na.rm is FALSE, any NaN or NA makes that column NA_real_. When no value remains, the column is plain NaN.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K, one median per selected column.

translation.description: Calculates the median for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage: colMedians(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, dim=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A 1-d vector is accepted when dim is set; it is filled column-major, as R stores a matrix. Integer values stay on the integer path. Floating values are computed as float64. Logical input is rejected.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row. The median of each column uses these rows.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column. Zeros are dropped, negatives exclude, and logical values are recycled. The result follows this order.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values are excluded. This is na.rm. False returns R's NA when any selected value is missing.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the number of rows and columns. This is dim. in R. None uses the shape of a 2-d x. A 1-d x is filled in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. It must be TRUE or FALSE. The result is a plain array, with no names attached.

translation.details: The scan lives in the Rust crate rowmedians, the same routine as rowMedians with by_row false, matching matrixStats src/rowMedians.c. Any NaN, including R's NA, makes that column NA_real_ when na_rm is false. A column with no remaining values is plain NaN. An even count averages the two central order statistics, and each integer is cast to float64 before that average. The result is always float64.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length K, one median per selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowmedians import colMedians

x = np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F")
colMedians(x)
